episode.brief: Review the simulated SaaS launch packet in sources/contract_packet. Identify contradictions and launch blockers, prepare a concise issue matrix in results/issues.csv and negotiation memo in results/memo.md, and save final.json. Do not execute or sign the agreement and distinguish documented facts from business assumptions.

source.adaptation: Preserves cross-document compliance review with an original SaaS contract packet and a late business-owner pilot authorization.

summary: Reconcile an MSA, customer DPA, architecture note, and sales promise before a private pilot agreement resolves the launch path.
title: SaaS launch contract issue review
